@Bettina Kroll, I couldn't set up the Monday 08:00 digest. The scheduler returned a credentials error from my session, so I couldn't create the recurring job or check whether one already exists. Please don't count on it starting Monday 19 Oct until it's confirmed. Once scheduling is working, I can set it up for 08:00 Chicago time, pulling from #coastal-team and #coastal-random.

Two notes on the digest's content:
- #coastal-random has the same members as this channel (you, Kwame and Sofia), so combining the two is fine.
- I'd leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoices). Those go only to finance and the account owner. Operational items such as seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and meetings are fine.
